refusal.finishedEarlierMove: Dark Factory first finished an earlier move into {{distro}}. Reload the window, then start this move again.
refusal.hostUpdateRequired: The {{distro}} host runs an older version of Dark Factory. Update it in Settings, then try again.
refusal.pauseFailed: Dark Factory could not pause the terminals in these projects, so nothing was moved. Paused terminals start again when you open them. Try again.
refusal.previewFailed: Dark Factory could not check these projects. Try again.
refusal.startFailed: Dark Factory lost contact with the move. Open this dialog again to see where it stands.

result.automationsPendingMany: {{n}} automations are off on the host for now. Dark Factory keeps asking the host to turn them back on.
result.automationsPendingOne: One automation is off on the host for now. Dark Factory keeps asking the host to turn it back on.
result.browserLoginsHostUnknown: Browser logins were not copied, because Dark Factory could not identify the host’s browser profile. Sign in again in the host’s browser tabs.
result.moved: Reload this window to see the projects under the {{distro}} host. Dark Factory backs up unsaved files before it reloads.
result.reloadCheckpointRefused: Dark Factory could not back up unsaved files, so the window did not reload. Close this dialog, save or close those files, then use Reload now in the notice that stays open.
result.waiting: The move may have reached the {{distro}} host, but the host is not answering. These projects stay read-only here until it does. Connect the host in Settings, then open this dialog again and start a move: Dark Factory finishes or undoes this one first.

unfinished.many: {{n}} automations moved to the {{distro}} host are still off. Dark Factory keeps asking the host to turn them back on.
unfinished.one: One automation moved to the {{distro}} host is still off. Dark Factory keeps asking the host to turn it back on.
